baseline_files.CLAUDE.md:
# PR contract rules
- When a public route changes, its HTTP method and path must be updated in docs/api/; unrelated edits do not count.
- A newly introduced static environment key must be present in .env.example; existing keys do not require an edit.
- Code examples in strings or comments are not registered routes.
baseline_files..drift-gate.yml:
rules:
  - id: api-doc
    when:
      any_changed: ['src/routes/**']
      min_change_intensity: route-contract-change
    require:
      groups:
        - name: API docs
          any_changed: ['docs/api/**']
          content: api-routes
    severity: blocker
  - id: env-example
    when:
      any_changed: ['src/config/**']
      min_change_intensity: config-key-added
    require:
      groups:
        - name: Environment sample
          all_changed: ['.env.example']
          content: env-keys
    severity: blocker
